info.brief: Real-time shadows from one light source, the sun, and many point light sources,
info.description:
Real-time shadows from one light source, the sun, and many point light sources,
wired into a render script. Call `init(self)` from the render script's `init`,
`update(self)` from its `update`, and `draw_upscaled(self)` after drawing the world
when a post effect is on (see `light_and_shadows/render/default.render_script`, the
lines marked `-- L_S Injection`). The settings fields are read every frame. Vector
fields are mutated in place; assigning a new value to any other field goes through a
cast, since a namespace import is read-only:
`(light_and_shadows as { fxaa: boolean }).fxaa = true`.

elements.name: shadow
elements.brief: Whether the sun casts shadows. The default is `true`.
elements.description: Whether the sun casts shadows. The default is `true`.

elements.name: upscale
elements.brief: Whether the main render target is upscaled. When on, every object is first rendered
elements.description:
Whether the main render target is upscaled. When on, every object is first rendered
to a render target no larger than the project settings size, which is then placed on
the screen with linear scaling. Add `light_and_shadows/props/render_target_quad.go`
to the main scene to use it. The default is `false`.

elements.name: fxaa
elements.brief: Whether FXAA anti-aliasing is applied to the final image. The default is `false`.
elements.description: Whether FXAA anti-aliasing is applied to the final image. The default is `false`.

elements.name: mix
elements.brief: Whether depth of field is on. `dof` sets it. The default is `false`.
elements.description: Whether depth of field is on. `dof` sets it. The default is `false`.

elements.name: discard_threshold
elements.brief: The alpha below which the sprite shader discards semitransparent pixels. The default is `0.5`.
elements.description: The alpha below which the sprite shader discards semitransparent pixels. The default is `0.5`.

elements.name: get_far_near_z_from_camera
elements.brief: Whether the reference render script reads the near and far Z planes from the camera component into `light_and_shadows.constants`. Set it to `false` to set `near_z` and `far_z` by hand. The default is `true`.
elements.description: Whether the reference render script reads the near and far Z planes from the camera component into `light_and_shadows.constants`. Set it to `false` to set `near_z` and `far_z` by hand. The default is `true`.

elements.name: blur
elements.brief: Whether the game scene is blurred, so an unblurred GUI can be drawn on top. It uses the same render target as upscaling. The default is `false`.
elements.description: Whether the game scene is blurred, so an unblurred GUI can be drawn on top. It uses the same render target as upscaling. The default is `false`.

elements.name: blur_power
elements.brief: How strong the blur is, `1` to `10`. The default is `2.5`.
elements.description: How strong the blur is, `1` to `10`. The default is `2.5`.

elements.name: blur_resolution
elements.brief: How much the blur render target is reduced in size, for speed. The default is `2`.
elements.description: How much the blur render target is reduced in size, for speed. The default is `2`.

elements.name: focus
elements.brief: The depth-of-field focus position, in `z`.
elements.description: The depth-of-field focus position, in `z`.

elements.name: depth_bias
elements.brief: The shadow depth bias. Too high a bias detaches shadows from their objects; too low a bias causes shadow acne. The default is `0.0004`.
elements.description: The shadow depth bias. Too high a bias detaches shadows from their objects; too low a bias causes shadow acne. The default is `0.0004`.

elements.name: max_lights
elements.brief: How many point light sources the shader processes at once, at most `16`. The default is `8`.
elements.description: How many point light sources the shader processes at once, at most `16`. The default is `8`.

elements.name: rt_list
elements.brief: Every render target `render_target` created, keyed by name.
elements.description: Every render target `render_target` created, keyed by name.

elements.name: polygon_offset
elements.brief: The polygon offset applied while drawing the shadow map. Raise it to reduce shadow acne; lower it if shadows detach from their casters.
elements.description: The polygon offset applied while drawing the shadow map. Raise it to reduce shadow acne; lower it if shadows detach from their casters.

elements.name: zoom
elements.brief: The zoom `update` computed for upscaling, `1` when `upscale` is off.
elements.description: The zoom `update` computed for upscaling, `1` when `upscale` is off.

elements.name: dof
elements.brief: Turns depth of field on or off.
elements.description: Turns depth of field on or off.

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: The depth-of-field options. Omitted, every setting keeps its value.

elements.name: render_target
elements.brief: Returns the render target named `name`, creating it with a color buffer and, unless
elements.description:
Returns the render target named `name`, creating it with a color buffer and, unless
`no_depth` is set, a depth texture. A target that exists at another size is resized.

parameters.name: name
parameters.doc: The render target name, also its key in `rt_list`.

parameters.name: no_depth
parameters.doc: `true` creates the target without a depth buffer.

elements.name: set_orthographic_projection
elements.brief: Sets an orthographic shadow projection, used for directional light. `init` sets one.
elements.description: Sets an orthographic shadow projection, used for directional light. `init` sets one.

parameters.name: proj_w
parameters.doc: The width of the area the shadow is projected on.

parameters.name: proj_h
parameters.doc: The height of the area the shadow is projected on.

parameters.name: near_z
parameters.doc: The near clipping plane. The default is `-500`.

parameters.name: far_z
parameters.doc: The far clipping plane. The default is `500`.

elements.name: set_perspective_projection
elements.brief: Sets a perspective shadow projection, cast in the direction of `sun_dir` in
elements.description:
Sets a perspective shadow projection, cast in the direction of `sun_dir` in
`light_and_shadows.constants`. Experimental.

parameters.name: fov
parameters.doc: The field of view in radians. The default is `3.14 / 1.5`.

parameters.name: aspect
parameters.doc: The aspect ratio. The default is `1`.

parameters.name: near_z
parameters.doc: The near clipping plane. The default is `50`.

parameters.name: far_z
parameters.doc: The far clipping plane. The default is `500`.

elements.name: init
elements.brief: Sets up the shadow map, the orthographic shadow projection and the render
elements.description:
Sets up the shadow map, the orthographic shadow projection and the render
constants on the render script. Call it from the render script's `init`.

elements.name: update_light
elements.brief: Writes the sun, the point light sources, the ambient and fog values and the camera
elements.description:
Writes the sun, the point light sources, the ambient and fog values and the camera
values from `light_and_shadows.constants` into the render constants. `update` calls it.

elements.name: render_shadows
elements.brief: Draws every object tagged `shadow` into the shadow map. `update` calls it while
elements.description:
Draws every object tagged `shadow` into the shadow map. `update` calls it while
`shadow` is on. The render script's `self.predicates` must carry `shadow`,
`shadow_local`, `shadow_instanced`, `shadow_instanced_billboard`,
`shadow_instanced_textured`, `shadow_skinned_instanced` and `shadow_skinned`.

elements.name: update
elements.brief: Updates the light constants, draws the shadow map, and creates or resizes the main
elements.description:
Updates the light constants, draws the shadow map, and creates or resizes the main
and blur render targets a post effect needs. Call it from the render script's
`update`.

elements.name: draw_upscaled
elements.brief: Blurs the main render target when depth of field or blur is on, then draws it to the
elements.description:
Blurs the main render target when depth of field or blur is on, then draws it to the
screen, with FXAA when `fxaa` is on. Call it after the world is drawn to the main
render target. The render script's `self.predicates` must carry `upscale`.

properties.name: blur_power
properties.brief: How strong the blur effect is, `2` to `10`. Omitted, `blur_power` keeps its value.
properties.description: How strong the blur effect is, `2` to `10`. Omitted, `blur_power` keeps its value.

properties.name: focus_range
properties.brief: How wide the focus zone is, `0.1` to `4`. Omitted, `focus_range` in `light_and_shadows.constants` keeps its value.
properties.description: How wide the focus zone is, `0.1` to `4`. Omitted, `focus_range` in `light_and_shadows.constants` keeps its value.

properties.name: blur_resolution
properties.brief: How much the blur render target is reduced in size, for speed; `1` to `2` is enough.
properties.description:
How much the blur render target is reduced in size, for speed; `1` to `2` is enough.
`dof` copies it with no fallback, so it is required: an options table without it
leaves `blur_resolution` nil and the next `update` fails.

properties.name: upscale
properties.brief: Whether to upscale the main render target. `dof` sets `upscale` to `false` when it is omitted.
properties.description: Whether to upscale the main render target. `dof` sets `upscale` to `false` when it is omitted.
